questions.q: What is the standard cadence rate for Quick Time in USAF drill?
questions.explanation: AFMAN 36-2203 Ch. 1 defines Quick Time cadence as 100 to 120 steps per minute.

questions.q: In USAF drill, on which foot is the command 'TO THE REAR, MARCH' called?
questions.explanation: In AFMAN 36-2203, 'TO THE REAR, MARCH' is issued as the right foot strikes the ground.

questions.q: What is the standard step length for Quick Time marching in USAF drill?
questions.explanation: Standard step length for USAF Quick Time is 24 inches (measured heel to heel).

questions.q: Which command allows formation members to break position but remain in the immediate area?
questions.explanation: 'FALL OUT' permits personnel to relax and leave their position while staying nearby.

questions.q: In a flight line formation, what is the distance between ranks?
questions.explanation: Distance between ranks (measured from chest of rear airman to back of front airman) is 40 inches.

questions.q: According to Army TC 3-21.5, what are the two main parts of a standard drill command?
options: Preparatory command and Command of execution
questions.explanation: Commands consist of a Preparatory Command (what to do) and Command of Execution (when to do it).

questions.q: In Army drill, on which foot is the command 'Rear, MARCH' given while marching?
questions.explanation: Under TC 3-21.5, 'Rear, MARCH' is called on the right foot.

questions.q: What is the march cadence rate for 'Double Time' in Army drill?
questions.explanation: Army Double Time cadence is exactly 180 steps per minute.

questions.q: What is the step length taken during normal Quick Time in Army drill?
questions.explanation: Army Quick Time step length is 30 inches.

questions.q: What is the correct position of hands at Attention under Army drill standards?
options: Cupped with thumbs along trouser seams
questions.explanation: Hands are cupped with thumbs along the trouser seam line.

questions.q: Under MCO 5060.2M, what distance is maintained between ranks in column formation?
questions.explanation: Distance between ranks in USMC drill is 40 inches.

questions.q: What is the step length for Half Step in Marine Corps drill?
questions.explanation: Half Step in Marine Corps drill is 15 inches.

questions.q: On which foot is the command for 'Right Flank, MARCH' given while marching?
questions.explanation: Right flank execution commands are called on the left foot.

questions.q: What command aligns a Marine squad at normal interval?
questions.explanation: 'DRESS RIGHT, DRESS' aligns elements with left arm extended horizontally.

questions.q: Which official publication governs Civil Air Patrol Drill & Ceremonies?
questions.explanation: CAPP 60-33 is the official Civil Air Patrol Drill and Ceremonies Pamphlet.

questions.q: What USAF manual does Civil Air Patrol drill primarily model its standards after?
questions.explanation: CAP Drill standards mirror USAF AFMAN 36-2203.

questions.q: Which position of rest permits cadets to talk unless instructed otherwise?
questions.explanation: On 'REST', members may talk while keeping their right foot fixed in position.
